site_name: King's Cross Central estate (Granary Square and the pedestrian boulevards)
North End, Croydon - northern end (North End / London Road, by West Croydon)
address: North End at its junction with London Road, Croydon town centre [uncertain - the Met has never published the mounting point; 'North End and London Road' is the Met's own March 2025 description, and 'either end of North End' the description used in Jan 2026 reporting]
installed_date: 2025-07 [uncertain - announced March 2025 for 'summer 2025' installation; first static deployment recorded in the Met's own log is 01/10/2025]
notes: One of the two mounting locations of the UK's first fixed police LFR installation. Cameras are attached to existing lampposts and buildings and the feed is monitored remotely; the Met states the cameras are switched on only during an authorised deployment when officers are on the ground to respond, not continuously. Inside Croydon reported (19 Jan 2026) that 15 individual camera units were installed across the two locations at either end of North End - the Met has never confirmed a unit count. No exact pole, address or coordinate has ever been published.

site_name: North End, Croydon - southern end (South End of the pedestrianised high street)
address: Southern end of North End, Croydon town centre, near the George Street / Croydon flyover end [uncertain - exact mounting point never published]
notes: The second of the two mounting locations. The Met's own May 2026 statement describes 'static cameras at two locations, at the north and south ends of Croydon's high street'. The Met's published 2025 deployment record logs these operations under the location label 'North End, Croydon' with per-operation dates and durations (e.g. 01/10/25 4h40m, 15/10/25 4h12m, 18/12/25 1h43m), which is the only site-level primary evidence of when the fixed cameras were actually running.

address: Victoria Underground Station, Terminus Place, London
notes: The first-ever use of live facial recognition inside a London Underground station, on 11 August 2026: 6h30m, watchlist 673, 33,545 estimated faces, zero alerts.
